description.narrative: The Climate Promise 2 will support the NDC implementation in the following ways:a) Strengthening the integration of gender and social inclusion into the NDC implementation plan b) Building synergies among the existing climate policies and plans and reinforcing climate action integration into the national and sub-national development plansc) Developing long-term climate action visiond) Building the institutional capacity of the key government agencies on climate actione) Improving coordination and collaboration among the stakeholders to faciliate the NDCs implementation and facilitate participatory LT-LEDS development The support will complement several UNDP programmes in the country, mainly the ongoing climate change mitigation and climate change adaptation projects. The support will contribute toward strengthening the climate action governance and facilitating the collaboration among the climate change stakeholders at the national and sub-national levels. In addition, the support will provide significant contribution in building the gender awareness and gender sensitivity among the stakeholders to ensure that the climate actions are gender-responsive and socially inclusive.
